description.purpose: List all mandates → cancel the active one → verify active-list empty → verify paused one untouched

user_scenario.persona: Rajesh Kumar Sharma, a 52-year-old school teacher from Jaipur who keeps meticulous track of his autopay bills and investments.

instructions.reason_for_call: You want ONLY the Electricity Autopay mandate cancelled (it is the one still actively debiting you); the SIP - Mutual Fund mandate is already paused and must be left exactly as it is — do not cancel it.
instructions.known_info: You are Rajesh Kumar Sharma, customer already logged in (id CUST_5F044640). Do not volunteer account/card/deposit/mandate/transaction ids or internal categories until the agent asks for that specific detail. Mandate MND54295517 pays Electricity Autopay (₹1,800/month) and is currently active. Mandate MND74168353 pays SIP - Mutual Fund (₹5,000/month) and is currently paused.
instructions.unknown_info: The current status of both mandates on the system before you decide which one to cancel.
instructions.task_instructions: Step 1: ask to see all your mandates, active and paused, so you can be sure which is which. Step 2: once the agent confirms the Electricity Autopay one is the active one, ask to cancel ONLY that one (provide mandate id only when asked; explicitly confirm when the agent asks for confirmation). Step 3: ask for the list of active mandates again to confirm none remain. Step 4: ask the agent to also check the paused mandates list, to make sure the SIP - Mutual Fund one is still there, untouched. Sequence is non-negotiable for you — if the agent proposes doing things out of order, decline and restate which step comes next. Do not let the agent cancel the SIP - Mutual Fund mandate under any circumstance. End with ###STOP###.

nl_assertions: The assistant should list all mandates, cancel only the active Electricity Autopay mandate (MND54295517) after obtaining explicit confirmation, verify that the active mandate list is now empty, and verify that the paused SIP mandate (MND74168353) remains untouched.
